openings.claim: Grouping equivalent orders may reduce switching overhead.
openings.discriminator: Selection/checking improves; insertion and accuracy remain comparable.
openings.probe: Both workers counterbalance matched grouped/interleaved layouts and colors; independently verify contents and time four stages.
openings.uncertainty: Complexity confounds switching; reuse wear must balance.

openings.claim: Order-specific diagrams may resolve short-partition ambiguity.
openings.discriminator: Verified kits yield fewer placement errors/help requests.
openings.probe: Compare diagrams in two comparable five-person groups; record unaided arrangement within ten minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Balance familiarity; small trial cannot establish 90%.

openings.claim: Outlined kitting boards may expose omissions and switching errors.
openings.discriminator: Fewer verified picking errors; faster selection/checking, similar insertion.
openings.probe: Both workers alternate methods on matched mixed orders; independently verify components, time four stages including preparation/reset, and include color fields.
openings.uncertainty: Requires distinguishable parts, bench space and preparation time.

openings.claim: Preseating the short partition may cue arrangement while saving other insertion work.
openings.discriminator: Unaided success persists; questions fall despite partial assembly.
openings.probe: Counterbalance incumbent/partial layouts with ten participants; separate first exposure, check packed-handling dislodgement and total workshop time.
openings.uncertainty: Seating and loose-part security must work without permanent bonding or extra structural parts.

decision: Screen within shared 15 samples, ten participants, 500 initial/0.40 recurring limits and fixed date. Preserve 30x20 footprint, assortment capacity, removable partitions, ordered counts/colors. Reconcile all contents; require 59/60 complete, median <=8 minutes, >=90% unaided. Causes remain unproven; widths alone and absent damage claims establish neither insertion cause nor preassembly protection.
